what: XGP pilot round 2, fold 0, inner validation only; pre-registered before any GPU run
selection_rule: Final XGP = the eligible XGP variant with the highest mean LCI_val over {70%, 90%} x {normal, older-like} windows (mean over seeds). Eligible = mean pooled 7-class macro-F1 on the normal inner-val windows >= the best baseline's mean F1 - 1 pt, at both levels. Baselines: l1, l1_kd, snip_kd, park, park_kd. Ties within 0.005 -> the variant with fewer components (keep-score 1, + worst-class 1, + augmentation 1). If no variant is eligible, no fallback: report and stop. Variants: xgp_kd (beta in {0.05, 0.1, 0.3}), xgp_worstclass_kd, xgp_aug_kd, xgp_worstclass_aug_kd; the variants' beta at a level = the beta of xgp_kd picked at that level by the same eligibility and LCI criterion on that level alone (ties within 0.005 -> the smaller beta; none eligible -> the highest F1, flagged), and xgp_kd enters the rule with that beta.
fairness_rule_step9: Step 9: whatever recipe and E_ft the final XGP uses, L1 and SNIP-score pruning get the same in the grid; Park runs as published (CE + gamma_P L_AM) and as park_kd. E_ft = 20 for every method in Step 9 if l1_kd_e20 beats l1_kd (seed 0, same level) by more than 1 pt pooled macro-F1 (normal windows) at either level; otherwise 10.
